caption: The video captures a close-up scene set against a stark black background, focusing on a tall glass filled with ice and a slice of lime perched on the rim. A hand enters the frame from the right, holding a clear glass bottle with visible text 'GINGER BEER' and 'THE ORIGINAL'. The hand tilts the bottle, pouring a stream of liquid into the glass. The liquid flows continuously into the glass without visible splash or droplets scattering. The hand remains in position throughout the sequence, holding the bottle steady.
conditions: first frame, caption, existing requirements; no future target
physical_dependency_analysis:
OBSERVED: Glass holds ice + lime; hand holds labeled bottle; liquid flows steadily into glass.  
INTERACTION: Hand tilting bottle → liquid flows due to gravity and bottle angle.  
PERSISTENCE: Flow continues as long as bottle is tilted and liquid remains in bottle.  
INTERVENTION: If bottle stops tilting → flow ceases; if hand withdraws → flow stops.
